bootstrap.algorithm: random.Random + SHA256-derived seed; resample three whole windows within each fixed source
bootstrap.centering: source means recomputed inside each bootstrap draw
bootstrap.undefined: omit undefined correlation draws and report count

denominator_provenance: Stored diagnostic ratios: inspected source divides action/queue/pressure counts by max(n_decisions,1), request changes by 72 input requests. Historic per-window decision counts are not serialized in these audits; no event-weighted or event-count inference is reconstructed. Source inspection is not execution attestation. Request changes include completion-time or SLO-status changes and unmatched completions.
estimand: Pearson correlation across the fixed equal-weight window-rate design; not event-weighted and not correlation of averaged windows
interaction: all 63 observed interactions zero; no equivalence CI or significance claim
interval_interpretation: Conditional percentile bootstrap sensitivity under within-source window exchangeability. Three deliberately selected windows per source do not justify calibrated population coverage, production generalization, or new significance claims.
label: POST_HOC_STAGE2A2
selection: early/middle/late deterministic windows, not probability samples
statistical_unit: upstream source window; all three rates and both diagnostic pairs retained together
